course.title: Biology at UBC's Vancouver campus

Faculty Faculty of Science
Degree Bachelor of Science
Completed IB Diploma, including at least three Higher Level courses.

uk.title: Biology at UBC's Vancouver campus (United Kingdom requirements)
quotes: Standing in at least six academic subject areas (GCSE, AS Levels, A Levels), including English, with at least three academic A Levels or six AS Levels.
A minimum grade of C in English Literature or English Language at the GCSE, AS, or A Level.
Degree-specific requirements: Science Math (A or AS Level) Chemistry (GCSE) Physics (GCSE; may be waived with grades of A in A-Level Math and A-Level Chemistry)

us.title: Biology at UBC's Vancouver campus (United States requirements)
quotes: Graduation from an academic or college preparation program at a US regionally accredited school.
English (composition/literature) to the senior level.
Three years of mathematics to the junior level.
A minimum grade of B- in an English course to at least the junior level.
Applicants who choose not to submit a standardized test score will not be disadvantaged.

Degree-specific requirements: Science Pre-Calculus (AP or high school Calculus is recommended if you’re pursuing a BSc) One year of Chemistry One year of Physics (may be waived with grades of A in Pre-Calculus Math and AP Chemistry)

admissions.threshold: Biology: at least six academic subjects (GCSE, AS, A-Level) including English, with at least three A-Levels (or six AS-Levels) and at least a C in English. Science: Maths at A or AS Level, plus GCSE Chemistry and Physics (Physics may be waived with A grades in A-Level Maths and Chemistry).

Biology: completed IB Diploma with at least three Higher Level courses. Science: IB Maths Analysis and Approaches (SL or HL) or Applications and Interpretations HL, and one of IB Biology, Chemistry or Physics.

Biology: a US diploma from a regionally accredited school, senior-level English, three years of maths and at least B- in English; SAT/ACT optional. Science: Pre-Calculus, a year of Chemistry and a year of Physics.
